blocks.text: MANDUE CITY, Cebu – Over 100 homes were reduced to ashes after a fire broke out in a residential area in Barangay Labogon, Mandaue City, early evening on Tuesday, October 20. Initial reports estimated the damage caused by the three-hour fire at P1.5 million.
